description: Wastewater Treatment in England is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs. This dataset contains data reported by water companies in accordance with the Urban Waste Water Treatment (England and Wales) Regulations 1994. The regulations implement the European Union Urban Waste Water Treatment Directive (91/271/EEC). Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs. It offers 4 resource(s) in ODS. The portal shows 2024-12-19 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
